intro.summary: Small southwest community on the Elbow River bluff around Britannia Plaza, made up almost entirely of single-detached homes on large lots.
intro.body: Britannia is a small community on the bluff above the Elbow River, west of Elbow Drive, with the Britannia Plaza shops at its edge. It has no semi-detached housing and only a few condos; nearly every home is a single-detached house on a large lot. New construction here usually means a custom home replacing an older one.
